docs.summary: A serializable, editor-configurable list of persistent calls Drop one on any component (public field or `[SerializeField]`) and the inspector lets authors wire up scene references, pick a method/property/field by reflection, and supply a basic argument. Invoke it from code (e.g. a button's click) to fire every configured call.
The configured calls. Mutated in place by the inspector.
Fires every call in order. A throwing call is logged and does not stop the rest.
